selection: Development758 only; highest Top+degree then fewer losses; best hybrid frozen before holds
initial: 60 fixed official answers; no accumulated follow-ups
strongLead: Direct linked official activity rated Like4 or StronglyLike5 retains current opening block; otherwise one activity-first probe
unknownCap: Bounded detour after2 or3 consecutive unfamiliar answers in the same field: one existing activity in a different field, then ordinary selection resumes. Affirmative career-specific evidence protects completion. No permanent field exclusion.
architecture: Both comparison arms use narrow building-layout preference and separate building-regulation-design preference; absent stays unknown; no profiles populated with new facts
rejectedRound: Hard field-wide caps lost supported cases on development; retained under rejected-cap-round1. No holdout evaluation preceded this revision.
